hook.text: Drive less, pay less. Pay-per-mile insurance charges a base rate plus a few cents per mile driven.

buildup.text: Companies like Metromile (now Lemonade) pioneered the model.

discovery.text: A GPS device or app tracks miles in real time.

twist.text: COVID made pay-per-mile suddenly logical. Remote workers driving 70% less were still paying full premiums.

climax.text: Pay-per-mile aligns cost with risk perfectly. Less driving means fewer accidents.

punchline.text: 3 cents a mile. Pay-per-mile insurance finally prices driving fairly.

quiz.question: Who benefits most from pay-per-mile insurance?
